contracts.rule: engines are spawned by path, never imported; engines do not import experiments
the matched Metronome baseline and Conveyor use the same worker observation producer; upstream vanilla Metronome remains a reference target

the abstract generated-token count is distinct from gateway delivery; output_token_cap is a generation upper bound, never a minimum delivery requirement; both current first-party workers set ignore_eos=True and normally run to their unequal per-segment decode caps, which formal matched-system comparisons must equalize

runner-specific validation checks service/client/session health, initialization, required observations and delivery syntax; output-cap checks differ between runners, and generic artifact finalization is not full manifest semantic validation; output below the cap is diagnostic; successful execution, exercised mechanisms and paper SLO acceptance are separate judgments

initial-context evidence requires every requested prefill to complete before periodic releases, excludes initialization output from later delivery, releases the automatic-eviction hold without evicting at the barrier, and rejects initialization timeout logs

eviction requires an idle session and safe execution/transfer references; the retained-prefix path runs at an idle scheduler transition, while fixed-tail diagnostics use a utility request with an idle check; current selection releases request references and uses a fixed tail margin, not intersection with confirmed host coverage; gaps may require recomputing a dependent suffix

activity, physical allocation, valid content, confirmed host coverage, bidirectional transfer state and shared references are separate dimensions; allocation or a store cursor does not establish copy completion; block pools, transfer events and runtime references determine state

the pinned client uses non-namespaced /tmp shard files and shared ports, so runs must not overlap; managed workflow deletes stale shard and aggregate files, requires every expected shard plus the controller to recreate results, and cleans temporary files on exit

design requirement: prefetch failure, capacity deferral, demand overtaking and later eviction must preserve a valid demand-recovery path; current code provides such paths but source review is not exhaustive concurrency validation; completed-cache publication and reference lifetimes require separate checks
formal evidence is clean; dirty diagnostic evidence carries a reconstructable patch artifact

current prototype, measured path, model/modality, output architecture, hardware, topology, and experiment profile do not define paper scope until the paper contract and experiment matrix are explicitly frozen
